question: How do I replace a GFCI outlet in my kitchen that keeps tripping?
answer: To replace a GFCI outlet, first turn off the power to the outlet at the main electrical panel. Remove the outlet cover plate and any screws holding the outlet in place. Carefully pull the outlet out of the electrical box. Disconnect the wires from the old outlet and connect them to the new outlet. Make sure to match the wires to the correct terminals. Replace the outlet in the electrical box and secure it with screws. Finally, replace the outlet cover plate and turn the power back on at the main electrical panel.
